items.title: Ronaldo Explains Portugal Walkout, Accuses Coach Jesus of Breaking His Word
items.summary: Published by: The Fatu Network Cristiano Ronaldo has broken his silence over his decision to leave Portugal’s national team camp, accusing head coach Jorge Jesus of twice breaking his word while accepting responsibility for walking out on the squad. In a lengthy statement rele...
